description: A Three.js-powered 3D shelf wall that displays life achievements across multiple categories. Each category has its own shelf row and a unique 3D shape: trophy cups for projects, globes for mobilities, scrolls for scientific papers, and stars for awards. The visual style seamlessly blends with the Quint Hugo theme's clean, minimal aesthetic.

concept.metaphor: Life is a series of accomplishments. Each one earns an object that sits on your personal display shelf — a hall of everything you've achieved, organized by type.
concept.visual_style: Modern minimalist wall of floating shelves. No wood textures, no skeuomorphism. Clean geometry, soft lighting, subtle shadows. Each shelf row is labeled with its category name. Objects are visually distinct per category but share the same material language.
concept.interaction: Objects gently idle-rotate. On hover, the object lifts slightly and a tooltip appears with details. On click, navigates to a URL. Each shelf row has a small label on the left edge.

categories.description: Each category maps to a unique 3D shape and a Hugo content type value. Items are grouped onto shelf rows by category.

tech_stack.3d_engine: Three.js (r160+, ES module via CDN importmap)
tech_stack.hugo_integration: Single 'shelf' content section with a 'type' field in frontmatter to distinguish categories
tech_stack.fallback: 2D CSS grid grouped by category for mobile and no-WebGL browsers
tech_stack.module_loading: Use <script type='importmap'> to map 'three' to CDN, then import in trophy-shelf.js

theme_integration.dark_mode_detection_in_js: window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches — listen for changes with addEventListener('change', ...) to update scene materials and lighting in real-time.

description.description: Short description shown on hover tooltip

date.description: Completion/achievement date. Used for ordering items left-to-right within their shelf row (oldest left, newest right).

item_type.description: Determines which shelf row and 3D shape to use.

link.description: External link. If empty, click does nothing. Tooltip still shows on hover. NOTE: 'url' is reserved by Hugo for page URL overrides, so we use 'link' instead.

image.description: Path to image (square, min 256x256). Mapped onto object plaque/face. Falls back to canvas-rendered first letter of title.

tags.description: Skill/tech tags shown on hover tooltip

accent_color.description: Hex color override for this item's 3D material. Falls back to category default_color.

weight.description: Override ordering within shelf row. Lower = further left. If omitted, ordered by date.

shape_definitions.note: Each shape is built entirely from Three.js built-in geometries. No external models or GLTF files. Each shape is constructed as a THREE.Group and returned by a factory function.

parts.name: scroll_end_right

parts.name: ribbon

parts.name: stand_cradle_left
parts.description: Small angled support that the scroll rests on (left side). A thin box rotated to form a V-cradle half.

parts.name: stand_cradle_right
parts.description: Right side of the V-cradle. Mirror of left.

parts.name: star_shape
parts.description: A 5-pointed star extruded into 3D. Built using THREE.Shape with 5 outer points and 5 inner points, then ExtrudeGeometry.

6. new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, { depth: 0.08, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.02, bevelSize: 0.02, bevelSegments: 3 })

easeOutBack_function.formula: function easeOutBack(t) { const c1 = 1.70158; const c3 = c1 + 1; return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(t - 1, 2); }

find_parent_item_group.description: Utility to walk up the object tree from an intersected mesh to find its parent group that exists in itemGroups[].
find_parent_item_group.logic: let obj = intersected; while (obj) { if (itemGroups.includes(obj)) return obj; obj = obj.parent; } return null;

positioning_logic: 1. Get the item group's world position: group.getWorldPosition(tempVec3)
2. Offset Y up by shape height: tempVec3.y += shapeHeight + 0.3
4. Convert to CSS pixels: x = (tempVec3.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * renderer.domElement.clientWidth
6. Set tooltip style: left = x + 'px', top = y + 'px', transform: translate(-50%, -100%)
7. Populate innerHTML with title, description, tags, category badge
